title: Nagendra Sah v. State of Bihar

content.caseIdentity: Nagendra Sah v. State of Bihar, (2021) 10 SCC 725
content.holding: Established the strict safeguard that Section 109 cannot be invoked against a spouse unless the prosecution independently proves the foundational fact of the spouse’s actual presence at the crime scene at the time of death.
content.relevance: Primary defence precedent to dismantle improper prosecution reliance on Section 109 in matrimonial cases.
